boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten distinct Saratoga Springs destinations on practical corridors from Skidmore, each paired with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: See the gallery spaces
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor — 320 Broadway
cards.notes: Walk the Broadway corridor to Saratoga Arts and check its gallery during listed public hours; confirm current exhibitions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts stop with gallery, theater, classroom, and studio space.
cards.evidence_claim: Saratoga Arts is at 320 Broadway and has gallery spaces, a black-box theater, classrooms, and studios; listed gallery hours include Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours listed: Wed 10am–4pm, Thu 2–8pm, Fri 10am–4pm, Sat 10am–2pm; verify holiday closures.

cards.title: Catch an in-store author event
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor — 424 Broadway
cards.notes: Check Northshire’s Saratoga events calendar, then browse or attend a listed in-store reading, conversation, or other bookstore program.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway bookstore with a current calendar of in-person events.
cards.evidence_claim: Northshire lists in-person events at its Saratoga store at 424 Broadway, including author discussions and story times.
cards.access_notes: Event dates, registration, and ticket requirements vary; use the store’s event listing before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center
cards.title: Pick up maps and walking-tour context
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor — 297 Broadway
cards.notes: Start on Broadway at the Visitor Center for local maps, brochures, directions, and information about self-guided or guided tours.
cards.short_summary: A practical orientation stop in the former Drink Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Visitor Center at 297 Broadway provides maps, brochures, directions, parking information, and walking and trolley tour information.
cards.source_title: Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center — Services
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Tuesday–Saturday; hours change seasonally and the center closes on national holidays.

cards.title: Walk among springs and the carousel
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor — Broadway, Circular, and Spring streets
cards.notes: Enter Congress Park from the Broadway corridor and follow the paths to its mineral springs, fountains, gardens, and seasonal carousel.
cards.short_summary: A public downtown park with walking paths and historic attractions.
cards.evidence_claim: Congress Park lies along Broadway, Circular, and Spring Streets and includes mineral springs, fountains, gardens, and a seasonal historic carousel.
cards.access_notes: The park is described as open to the public year-round; the carousel operates seasonally.

cards.title: Explore changing city-history exhibits
cards.subtitle: Congress Street off the Broadway corridor — Canfield Casino
cards.notes: From Broadway, head into Congress Park to the Canfield Casino and set aside time for the museum’s changing exhibits and three floors of collections.
cards.short_summary: A history museum inside the landmark Canfield Casino.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saratoga Springs History Museum presents changing exhibitions and public programs on three floors of the Canfield Casino at 1 E. Congress Street.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists daily 10am–4pm hours and paid admission, with student pricing; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Plan around a performance or jam
cards.subtitle: Phila Street corridor — 47 Phila Street
cards.notes: Use the performance schedule to choose a concert, jam, open mic, class, or other program, then enter through the courtyard off Phila Street.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Phila Street venue with performances and participatory programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Caffè Lena is on the second floor at 47 Phila Street and hosts evening performances, jams, and open mics, plus daytime jams and classes.
cards.access_notes: Programs and tickets vary; consult the venue schedule. Elevator access is available beyond the first-floor staircase.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of Racing and Hall of Fame
cards.title: Use the interactive Hall of Fame displays
cards.subtitle: Union Avenue corridor — 191 Union Avenue
cards.notes: Walk Union Avenue to the museum and explore its racing-history interpretation, including the immersive Hall of Fame Education Experience.
cards.short_summary: A Union Avenue museum devoted to American thoroughbred racing history.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum at 191 Union Avenue preserves and promotes thoroughbred-racing history and includes an immersive Hall of Fame Education Experience with interactive plaques.
cards.source_title: National Museum of Racing and Hall of Fame — Mission and History
cards.access_notes: The museum lists daily 9am–5pm hours; confirm admission and any program details before arrival.

cards.title: Read the grounds map before race day
cards.subtitle: Union Avenue corridor — 267 Union Avenue
cards.notes: Use NYRA’s official grounds and parking maps to orient yourself around the historic course, gates, drop-off area, and race-day routes.
cards.short_summary: A mapped Union Avenue landmark with a seasonal live-racing calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: NYRA identifies Saratoga Race Course at 267 Union Avenue and provides official grounds, interior, parking, and interactive seating maps.
cards.source_title: New York Racing Association — Saratoga Race Course Maps and Parking
cards.access_notes: Access, admission, and race-day operations vary; consult NYRA’s current visitor information before going.

cards.title: Follow the park’s signed loops and springs
cards.subtitle: Avenue of the Pines corridor — park entrances on Avenue of the Pines
cards.notes: Enter via Avenue of the Pines and use the state park map to plan a daylight walk among the park’s historic buildings, trails, and springs.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark park with mapped recreation and cultural sites.
cards.evidence_claim: Saratoga Spa State Park is a National Historic Landmark with cultural and recreational resources; its official directions identify Avenue of the Pines entrances.
cards.source_title: New York State Parks — Saratoga Spa State Park
cards.access_notes: Vehicle-entry fees can apply seasonally; use the official park page for current conditions and entrance details.

cards.title: See the current performance calendar
cards.subtitle: Avenue of the Pines corridor — 108 Avenue of the Pines
cards.notes: Use the SPAC calendar to choose a performance, then review the grounds map and visit guidance for the Avenue of the Pines venue.
cards.short_summary: An Avenue of the Pines performance venue with resident arts partners.
cards.evidence_claim: SPAC is at 108 Avenue of the Pines and presents live performances; its artistic partners include New York City Ballet and The Philadelphia Orchestra.
cards.access_notes: Ticketing, event times, and venue rules vary by performance; review the current event page before traveling.
